attempts.prompt: Create ONE wide educational raster stimulus with three equal side-by-side panels, large white gutters and margins, white studio background, exactly the same single actor and all the same props with identical scale, perspective, viewing angle and lighting throughout. Flat 2D children’s educational drawing using clear shapes, solid colors and dark clean outlines, of one recognizable anthropomorphic pig; same ears, tail and functional paws throughout. Draw or photograph the following Catalan causal brief without writing any words. LEFT baseline: Una esponja seca allargada és més ampla que el forat de l’anella rígida. CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: Comprimeix un extrem amb els dits i el fa entrar pel forat. L’anella estreny la part central. RIGHT result: L’anella envolta la cintura estreta de l’esponja. Els extrems s’han expandit a banda i banda. Continuity and accounting: Una sola anella gruixuda i una sola esponja bicolor, sense fissures. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image.
attempts.review: Es veu el primer extrem de l’esponja comprimit mentre passa per l’anella. Al final l’anella envolta la cintura estreta i els dos extrems de la mateixa esponja són sencers.
